name: 现摘现发翠绿多汁猕猴桃款
description: 果肉翠绿绵密、酸甜多汁的绿心猕猴桃，现摘现发

styleLock.direction: fresh green-heart kiwifruit e-commerce, fresh-picked and appetizing
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and spec screens, pale mint-green info panel #EFF6E3 for infographic and macro screens, vivid chartreuse field #7FBE3C for the benefit and closing screens, warm natural wood #B4844F and sunlit orchard green for scene and detail screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight-style diffused lighting with a top-front key light, gentle fill and soft natural contact shadows; glistening moist flesh and visible fine skin fuzz, never plastic-looking
styleLock.surfaceSystem: white glazed ceramic plate, warm natural wood plank #B4844F, round woven bamboo board, pale mint-green matte paper #EFF6E3
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep leaf-green #2F6B2A, labels 10-14pt, warm wood brown #B4844F reserved for natural surface tones
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single leaf-green accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for whole fruit with the fuzzy skin readable; whenever a fruit is halved the cut face always turns toward the camera; the whole fruit and the halved cross-section are paired at a fixed scale ratio across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh green-heart kiwifruit e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, pale mint-green info panel #EFF6E3, vivid chartreuse #7FBE3C, deep leaf-green text #2F6B2A and warm natural wood #B4844F; bright soft daylight-style diffused lighting with a top-front key light, gentle fill and soft natural contact shadows, glistening moist flesh and visible fine skin fuzz, never plastic-looking; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep leaf-green; consistent rounded rectangular info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end fresh-produce photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle with the cut face always turned toward the camera; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no plastic-looking fruit rendering.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，白底合规且果形与切面同时可信
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view, one whole fruit standing upright in the front 3/4, a second whole fruit behind it and one half-cut fruit in front with the cut face turned toward the camera, full fruit group visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key light with soft fill, soft contact shadow grounding the fruit
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One whole fruit standing upright in the front 3/4 view, a second whole fruit placed behind it and one half-cut fruit in front with the cut face turned toward the camera, photographed straight-on at eye level with the full fruit group visible and filling 60-70% of the frame as one complete balanced composition with natural breathing margins. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key light and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the fruit. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. 8K, commercial fresh-produce e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges, no plastic-looking waxy skin, no invented origin names, sugar content or certifications.

shots.lighting: bright soft diffused top light with gentle fill, moist flesh glistening, soft contact shadow
shots.background: vivid chartreuse field #7FBE3C holding a large white rounded inset card #FFFFFF
shots.props: two fresh green leaves and a few water droplets
shots.textZone: clean upper area of the white inset card with one headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2F6B2A and one short sub-line 「{selling_point_1}」

shots.props: a plain shallow white bowl on both panels, nothing else

shots.intent: 用真实果园环境与晨光代入新鲜现摘的联想

shots.lighting: natural early-morning sunlight filtering through the leaves, 5500K, dappled light with long soft shadows, soft contact shadow under the basket
shots.background: leafy orchard canopy with sun-dappled green foliage, warm red-brown soil path #8B5A3C low in the frame
shots.props: one shallow woven bamboo basket holding the fruit, no people
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} resting in a shallow woven bamboo basket at the edge of leafy orchard rows. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Negative: no people, no hands covering the product, no real place names, signs or geographic markers, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no plastic-looking fruit, no impossible shadows.

provenance.notes: 从 7 屏爆款猕猴桃详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源图书法标题字、产地与纬度宣称（地名全部删除）、品牌与规格数值、营养成分与功效文案、会员二维码与店铺角标。产品一律以 {product} 占位，规格、储藏、营养等无法验证的信息均改为 {callout} 文案槽，由使用方按实际信息填写。源图仅 7 屏，第 3 镜（痛点）与第 8 镜（收口促单）按水果生鲜详情页行业惯例补足；果皮绒毛与果肉剖面为同品种共通特征，机位与景别亦按行业惯例细化。
